keyEvents.text: Goal! Union Saint-Gilloise 0, Lech Poznań 1. Yannick Agnero (Lech Poznań) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Luis Palma.
Goal! Union Saint-Gilloise 0, Lech Poznań 2. Luis Palma (Lech Poznań) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Penalty saved. Raul Florucz (Union Saint-Gilloise) left footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Mateusz Lis (Lech Poznań).
Ross Sykes (Union Saint-Gilloise) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Guilherme Smith (Union Saint-Gilloise) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Robert Gumny (Lech Poznań) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Union Saint-Gilloise 1, Lech Poznań 2. Raul Florucz (Union Saint-Gilloise) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Louis Patris.
Delay in match (Union Saint-Gilloise).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Lech Poznań. Radoslaw Murawski replaces Gustav Berggren.
Substitution, Lech Poznań. Daniel Håkans replaces Luis Palma.

Goal! Union Saint-Gilloise 2, Lech Poznań 2. Kevin Rodríguez (Union Saint-Gilloise) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Louis Patris following a fast break.
Substitution, Union Saint-Gilloise. Dylan Aquino replaces Besfort Zeneli.
Substitution, Union Saint-Gilloise. Relebohile Mofokeng replaces Kevin Rodríguez.
Substitution, Lech Poznań. Joel Pereira replaces Robert Gumny.
Substitution, Lech Poznań. Allahyar Sayyadmanesh replaces Leo Bengtsson.
Substitution, Union Saint-Gilloise. Ilan Hurtevent replaces Raul Florucz.
Substitution, Union Saint-Gilloise. Rob Schoofs replaces Adem Zorgane.
Substitution, Lech Poznań. Wojciech Szymczak replaces Yannick Agnero.
Michal Gurgul (Lech Poznań) is shown the yellow card.
Radoslaw Murawski (Lech Poznań) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Union Saint-Gilloise 2, Lech Poznań 2.
